Project Name: Building Permit record created from ESR-2025-00308
Description: The reroofing project involves installing a multi-layer modified bitumen roofing system on a flat roof. The process begins with a thorough inspection and preparation of the roof deck ( separate permit required), including any necessary repairs to ensure a solid, clean, and dry surface. The first layer is the modified bitumen base sheet, which is applied using a hot asphalt, cold adhesive, or torch-down method, providing a strong foundation. Next, an intermediate layer of modified bitumen is installed for added protection and durability, again using the same application techniques. Finally, a cap sheet is applied as the top layer, offering a weather-resistant finish and sealing all seams and edges to prevent water infiltration. Flashing is installed at critical points, such as roof perimeters and penetrations, to ensure a watertight system. Throughout the project, strict safety protocols are followed, including debris removal and compliance with OSHA standards. The result is a long-lasting, durable roofing system designed to withstand the elements and provide superior waterproofing for flat roofs.
